title: Senior IT Specialist
description:
If you are a current DSV employee and interested in a position in another country, please contact your Human Resource representative to discuss the process and requirements of applying.


Job Req Number: 127472  

Time Type: Full Time


Department: Contract Logistics IT  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_



Position name: Senior IT Specialist  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_



Position target:  

This position is collaboration and link between DSV’s customers, DSV’s business functions and the regional and global IT departments reporting into the Team Lead BY WMS Core.

  



Tasks and responsibilities:  

STRATEGIC / TACTICAL  

* Collaborate with the Delivery and product function, other relevant DSV departments to support the delivery of business requirements with the standard DSV warehouse systems solutions and identify solutions for potential gaps.
* Collect review \& understand customer requirements and help in the translation of these into BRF/BRS for submission to the build part of IT
* Conduct IT Solution Reviews with IT Delivery team to maximize standardization and reusing existing solutions
* Continuous improvement of the standard warehouse solutions for faster implementation within the regional sites and support the creation of further regional and global standard solutions in the logistics space together with the other regional and global teams
* Maintain and develop the WMS and surrounding applications with high focus on standardization and code reusability, clear and understandable documentation.


GOVERNANCE  

* Adhere to the global and regional governance guidelines defined for all IT solutions and in particular the once in the logistics area
* Assist with code \& solution reviews
* Responsible for being cost conscience
* Support the IT architecture function in its mission, objective and action plans


RESEARCH AND EXPAND THE TOOLBOX FOR WMS SOLUTIONS  

* Research new opportunities for increasing productivity and growing profit within the function of WMS systems
* Communicate and collaborate with the BY WMS Core Lead, BY WMS Delivery Lead \& Director BY WMS on future functionality as market trends/demands are presented
* Collaborate with the Core \& Delivery teams in delivering those functionalities


EXECUTION  

* Act as an IT Technical/Functional resource on key DSV projects
* Provide senior consultancy on technical matters and logistic projects
* Act as interface between the demand functions and IT solutions to ensure internal and external customer requirements are met
* Secure on\-time creation of technical solutions, internal developments
* Analyze customer requirements, recommend, project manage \& manage the implementation of IT solutions in collaboration with business owner/account manager
* Continue to enhance skills through continuing education
* Participate in business implementations and full responsibility for end\-to\-end IT project work stream. Liaise with EDI group to ensure customer IT integration
* Coordinate information \& activities to ensure customer satisfaction in delivering warehouse management solutions
* Collaborate with regional project management team to manage time/resources and successfully deliver IT warehouse systems services
* Create and deliver in person or by teams’ presentations/demos on how IT enables warehouse solutions
* Identify gaps and/or shortcomings of DSV warehouse applications based on own’s observations, knowledge, customer’s requirements and competitor’s systems. Pro\-actively discuss these improvement opportunities with the global WMS teams in both Core and Support areas and where appropriate participate in continous improvement projects related to DSV’s standard warehouse solutions
* Support head of department with ad\-hoc IT projects as required


Special rights:  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_



Education and skills:  

Minimal requirements  

GENERIC REQUIREMENTS:  

* Ability to navigate and work with BY WMS (previously JDA, RedPrairie Discrete) and deploy applications in a MOCA environment.
* Advanced knowledge of Page Builder and .Net
* Basic knowledge of Java programming language.
* Good SQL command language and knowledge of relational Database.
* Experience with implementing EDI/B2B end to end customer supply chain solutions.
* General knowledge of working with different 3rd party SW providers.
* Capable of taking ownership of and implementing the project, including the end\-user contact, analysis, design, and documentation.
* Proven ability to maintain and implement high quality, reliable WMS solutions.
* Demonstrate thoroughness in system design and system testing with a minimum supervision


PERSONALITY TRAITS:  

* Excellent communication skills both written and oral and the ability to tailor these to the audience
* Ability to work in a diverse multi\-cultural environment
* Ability to move forward successfully with minimal direction: self\-motivated \& autonomous
* Capable of remaining professional \& effective considering sometimes very stressful situations
* Strong analytical skills in relation to logistics processes and the ability to translate these into the standard processes within a tier 1 WMS solution
* Pro\-active and willing to involve stakeholders in decision making process when needed
* Ready to take personal accountability for achieving individual and shared goals
* Able to influence and convince others in a way that results in acceptance, agreement and overall, more efficient and profitable logistics environment
* Credible with vendor, internal / external customers, peers and staff


LEADERSHIP \& MANAGEMENT  

* Demonstrates high levels of integrity
* Acts as a Role Model for Global Values and fully adhere to the Code of Conduct
* High energy and resilience, and calm under pressure
* Demonstrate business and financial awareness
* High commitment and positive attitude in the face of setbacks and obstacles
* Authentic, approachable, open and honest
* Effective listener
  

Minimal work experience:
  

Minimal requirements  

5 years professional experience in a transportation, logistics or supply chain management related role, preferably within the 3PL industry.

**DSV – Global transport and logistics**



Working at DSV means playing in a different league.



As a global leader in transport and logistics, we have been on an extraordinary journey of growth. Let’s grow together as we continue to innovate, digitalise and build on our achievements.



With close to 150,000 colleagues in over 90 countries, we work every day to offer solid services and meet our customers’ needs and help them achieve their goals. We know that the best way to achieve this is by bringing in new talent, fresh perspectives and ambitious individuals like you.



At DSV, performance is in our DNA. We don’t just work – we aim to shape the future of logistics. This ambition fuels a dynamic environment built on collaboration with world\-class team players, accountability and action. We value inclusivity, embrace different cultures and respect the dignity and rights of every individual. If you want to make an impact, be trusted by customers and grow your career in a forward\-thinking company – this is the place to be.


**Start here. Go anywhere**



Visit dsv.com

title: Service Desk Junior Engineer-Service Support
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**About Sopra Steria**  

Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end\-to\-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in\-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach. Sopra Steria places people at the heart of everything it does and is committed to putting digital to work for its clients in order to build a positive future for all. In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5\.6 billion.  

**The world is how we shape it.**

**Job Description**
-------------------


Total Experience Expected: 00\-01 years

* Provide **L1 technical support** to international users via phone, email, and chat.
* Troubleshoot issues related to **Windows/OS, MS Office, hardware, printers, networks, VPN, and Active Directory**.
* Log, categorize, prioritize, and track incidents using **ServiceNow** while meeting SLAs.
* Resolve issues using standard procedures and **escalate complex issues to L2/L3 teams**.
* Coordinate with technical teams and follow incidents through to resolution.
* Follow **ITIL processes, security guidelines, and support procedures**.
* Maintain accurate ticket documentation and provide clear user guidance.
* Handle multiple tickets effectively in a **fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment**.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Experience in **L1 Service Desk / Help Desk Support**.
* Strong knowledge of **OS, MS Office, Active Directory, VPN, ServiceNow, hardware, and networking**.
* Excellent **verbal and written communication**.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience supporting **international clients**.

  

**Additional Information (Travel \& Shift, etc.)**

* Willing to work from the office premises.
* Flexible \& Open to work in 24\*7 environment.
**Qualifications**
------------------


Any Stream Graduate

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.


All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.
